title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Credit Memo Standard: New Credit Line at a Line Review
content:
**Calculation.** At a line review of a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the line-review increase percentage is 0.5 times the card's largest single credit line increase percent. The new credit line is the current credit line plus the line-review increase percentage of the current credit line, but never above the card's highest line reachable through increases, and that amount is rounded down to a whole multiple of USD 100.00.

## Quantities and their records

| Quantity | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Current credit line | the card account record |
| Largest single credit line increase percent | the card's figure in the Northgate Retail Bank credit line schedule |
| Highest line reachable through increases | the card's figure in the same schedule |

## Order of the calculation

1. The line-review increase percentage is found: 0.5 times the card's largest single increase percent.
2. That percentage of the current credit line is added to the current credit line.
3. The result is held at the card's highest reachable line when it would pass it.
4. The amount is rounded down to a whole multiple of USD 100.00; nothing is rounded before this point.

## Worked figures (hypothetical card: largest single increase 30 percent, highest reachable line USD 10000.00)

The line-review increase percentage is 0.5 times 30, that is 15 percent.

| Current line | Plus 15 percent of it | Held at the highest line | New credit line |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 2000.00 | USD 2300.00 | USD 2300.00 | USD 2300.00 |
| USD 2450.00 | USD 2817.50 | USD 2817.50 | USD 2800.00 |
| USD 9500.00 | USD 10925.00 | USD 10000.00 | USD 10000.00 |

The second row shows the rounding down: USD 2817.50 becomes USD 2800.00, never USD 2900.00.
